theorems.statement: ∀ (C : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Prop), (∀ (r : ℕ) (I : Set ℕ), I.Infinite → ∃ J ⊆ I, J.Infinite ∧ ∀ j ∈ J, ∀ l ∈ J, C r j l) → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ r, C r (φ (r + 1)) (φ r)
